title: Fast test mode: tiers, --fast, --affected, --full in a git worktree with cached result (REQ-0096)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 timing report script and summary
AC3 --affected maps changed files to tests, falls back to --fast
AC4 --full result file with tree hash, reused when unchanged
AC5 fast+slow = all tests, untagged test runs in fast
AC7 known failures reported as known
AC8 --full runs in a throwaway git worktree in the background

user_notes.note: run the suite in a git worktree like _code-security-scanner; --fast / skip heavy; best rule: --full once per task before VERIFIED, cached by tree hash
